The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''25,811 before the Battle of Yavin''', also known as '''10,642 after the Tho Yor Arrival''', was a year in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic history]]. That year, a strike occurred at the mining colony of [[Ran Dan's Folly]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sunspot (Tython system)|Sunspot]] which led to violent riots, resulting [[Miner/Legends|miners]] leaving planet.<ref name="DOTJ">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>
